statusDefinitions.Designed: Documented design exists (docs/), no working code.
statusDefinitions.Implementing: Some working code exists (e.g. backend and tests) but not every layer (API, persistence, UI) is done.
statusDefinitions.Implemented: Business logic, persistence, API and UI all functional.
statusDefinitions.Tested: Implemented and covered by automated tests that pass.
statusDefinitions.Integration pending: Built, awaiting an external provider integration.
statusDefinitions.External approval required: Needs credentials, regulatory or commercial approval outside the codebase.
statusDefinitions.Production ready: Acceptance criteria met and all required tests pass.

features.notes: Bank reconciliation agent: for each unmatched statement line without an exact one-to-one match (up to 25 per run, oldest first), the AI model (Anthropic Claude) suggests ledger lines already in the books that add up to it, a receipt or payment against open invoices or bills, or an entry to one account, with a confidence and a reason. It sees short references, never ids; every proposal is checked against what it was shown; a person accepts or dismisses each, and accepting goes through the same matching, receipt and entry code as by hand. Tested with a scripted model and a local Messages API stand-in; waiting on ANTHROPIC_API_KEY for a live check.

features.notes: Each rule is a workflow definition (trigger, conditions, actions to roles or the customer/vendor). Approval needs every test passing and someone other than the last editor (workflows.manage); it creates or versions one workflow per rule and turns off workflows of removed rules. Every version (created, edited, approved, retired) is kept in an immutable table.
